generation.explanation: If you compound n times a year at 100% interest, your $1 becomes (1 + 1/n)^n dollars. With n=1 you get $2, with n=2 you get $2.25, monthly gives about $2.613, and daily about $2.7146. The growth doesn't blow up. It levels off at e ≈ 2.71828, even if you compound continuously. Drag the slider to change n and watch the dot climb toward the dashed line at e.
